*F-PKE* (Public-key encryption, KEM) is part of *Layer 3: Public-Key Primitives, Key Exchange, Messaging* in the UC functionality encyclopedia. Status: a canonical, well-established UC functionality.

*References:*

- Canetti. *Universally composable security: A new paradigm for cryptographic protocols*. In 42nd IEEE Symposium on Foundations of Computer Science (FOCS), pages 136–145, 2001.
- Goldwasser and Micali. *Probabilistic encryption*. Journal of Computer and System Sciences, 28(2):270–299, 1984.
- Küsters and Tuengerthal. *Joint state theorems for public-key encryption and digital signature functionalities with local computation*. In 21st IEEE Computer Security Foundations Symposium (CSF), pages 270–284, 2008.
